name: The Maid
appearance: A neat young servant in a plain cap and apron, quick-handed and quiet-footed, eyes lowered but missing nothing.
definition: A lady's maid who sees the household from below stairs — discreet, observant, and privy to secrets her mistress would not speak aloud. Loyal but not blind, she is the small, steady presence at the edge of every private scene.
voice: Soft and deferential, plain-spoken in private; she offers homely truth when the drawing-room manner is dropped.
